messages:
maya: CloudTrail alert flagged a PutKeyPolicy on KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/3f4b2c that added group/devs with kms:Decrypt. attaching brief audit excerpt.
sec_ops_bot: SECURITY ALERT: PutKeyPolicy detected on key 3f4b2c by jen@infra (console) — severity: high — rule: sensitive-kms-policy-change
omar: do we know what services use that key? any decrypts after the change?
maya: quick CloudWatch/Ct query: 7 Decrypt calls between 18:13–18:18 UTC. two of those touch customer_pii objects.
evan: can we apply a deny overlay to stop further decrypts while triaging?
ben: recommended emergency steps (short): 1) put explicit Deny overlay for group/devs 2) disable the key if needed 3) rotate data keys for exposed objects 4) collect CT evidence for postmortem
omar: commands from sec-admin box if we overlay: 
```
# fetch current policy
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id 3f4b2c --policy-name default > current-policy.json

# create deny overlay (deny devs Decrypt)
cat > deny.json <<EOF
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "EmergencyDenyDevs",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:group/devs" },
      "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
EOF

# merge/put policy (our runbook merges statements)
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id 3f4b2c --policy-name default --policy file://merged-policy.json

# or hard-stop
aws kms disable-key --key-id 3f4b2c
```
maya: I'll apply deny overlay first (less blast radius) and watch for AccessDenied. if it persists we disable.
sec_ops_bot: Action started: deny-overlay applied by maya at 2026-05-14T18:20:33Z
jen: I made the policy change trying to make dev testing easier — I thought group/devs only had encrypt for envelopes, sorry. standing by for rollback/next steps.
evan: thanks for owning it. jen, can you paste the policy you put? don't make further changes.
jen: policy excerpt I applied: 
```
"Statement": [
  {
    "Sid": "AllowDevUse",
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:group/devs" },
    "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
    "Resource": "*"
  }
]
```
ben: that explains it. immediate status: deny-overlay added at 18:20:33 UTC (maya); subsequent Decrypts from group/devs returned AccessDenied (CloudTrail). disable-key NOT executed.
maya: confirmed — CloudTrail shows AccessDenied for new attempts. collecting evidence and S3 object snapshots.
omar: next steps: rotate the data keys for the two customer_pii objects that were decrypted earlier. open ticket to coord with customer-data to re-encrypt with a new CMK.
evan: also list active sessions for principals in group/devs and rotate any long-lived access keys. run an IAM simulation of final policy.
ben: followups assigned: maya -> evidence upload to sec-case-458 (EOD), jen -> blameless timeline + link to PR (due tomorrow), omar -> data-key rotation coord (ASAP), evan -> IAM simulation + attach results.
maya: we should add an infra guard that blocks PutKeyPolicy which grants Decrypt to non-service roles. i'll file infra-guard PR post-incident.
jen: sorry again — i'll help with the PR and sandbox tests.
sec_ops_bot: Case sec-case-458 created by maya at 2026-05-14T18:31:12Z — incident severity: high — owner: ben
ben: good work team. once evidence is in the case i'll draft incident report and recommended infra guard changes. :thumbsup:
maya: closing triage channel; will reopen if anything regresses.
